trigger: quote.issued  (lead status -> quoted, premium stored on quote object)
stop_conditions: policy.bound  -> migrate lead to trucking_cross_sell_v1 / bound-customer track, stop this sequence
any human reply  -> stop automation, alert agent via SMS, hand off to human
opt-out / stop / no  -> DNC hard stop, suppression list
identity: From: David Hughes Insurance <david@yourdomain> · SMS from approved Brevo sender. Sign all: - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

steps.body: Hi {first_name} - David Hughes Insurance here. Your quote is ready: {premium_range} for {coverage_summary}. Two quick questions and I can firm that up today. This thread is monitored - just reply. - David

steps.subject: The difference between cheap and covered ({first_name})
steps.body: {first_name} - when you compare my number to others, compare the coverage lines too, not just the bottom dollar. The two places quotes usually get cheap: liability limits shaved down, and exclusions buried on page 4. Send me any competing quote and I'll line-item it against mine for free - if theirs is genuinely better, I'll tell you to take it. - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

steps.subject: What {business_class} risks are quoting at this week
steps.body: {first_name} - I ran {business_class} risks across 3 carriers this week. Rates for your class {moved_direction}. If your quote is more than a few weeks old it may already be stale - want me to re-run it fresh? Reply YES or grab 10 min: {booking_link} - David

steps.subject: This quote holds until {expiry_date}
steps.body: {first_name} - a heads up: the rate on your quote is locked until {expiry_date}. After that it re-rates, and carrier appetite for {business_class} shifts month to month. If you're still deciding, one short call protects today's number: {booking_link} - David

steps.subject: Closing your file (unless you tell me otherwise)
steps.body: {first_name} - I don't chase people. Your quote is still valid until {expiry_date}, but I'm closing your active file after today. If you want the coverage, reply ANY time - even months from now - and I'll re-open it. If you found coverage elsewhere, a one-word reply ('done') stops these messages instantly and I wish you the best. - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

trucking_new_authority.swap_day_9: mention that new-authority rates improve after clean months of operation - binding now builds that history

personal_home_auto.use: business_class = 'home & auto bundle', coverage_summary = '{home_value} home + {vehicle_count} vehicle(s)'
personal_home_auto.swap_day_5: bundle-savings angle: 'most households we audit are leaving 15-20% on the table split across two carriers'
personal_home_auto.swap_day_9: renewal-window angle if x_date known: 'if your current policy renews {x_date}, binding before it avoids a lapse flag'

commercial_general.use: default - business_class = lead.occupation, coverage_summary from quote lines

trigger_wiring.quote_issued: InsureFlow: on quote.status=issued -> enroll contact in Brevo list 'quote_followup', store {premium_range, coverage_summary, business_class, expiry_date=quote_date+30d}
trigger_wiring.bound_migration: on policy.bound -> remove from 'quote_followup', add to bound track
trigger_wiring.reply_detection: Brevo webhook -> inbound reply -> stop sequence + SMS agent + log_lead event
trigger_wiring.dnc: any STOP keyword -> suppression list, blocks all sequences

test_protocol.subject: David's own phone + email as lead #1
how: 1. Create a test lead in InsureFlow (name 'Dave Test', your cell + gmail)
2. Log a test quote with premium_range set
3. Confirm day-0 SMS arrives within the delay window
4. Do NOT reply - let day 2 email land; verify it reads personal, not robotic
5. Reply 'YES' on day 5 touch - confirm automation stops and you get the agent-alert SMS
6. Reset, then test the STOP keyword on another pass - confirm hard stop
7. Bind the test lead - confirm migration to bound sequence (trucking_cross_sell_v1)
test_protocol.what_to_listen_for: tone (plain-spoken, one ask per message), timing (not midnight sends), merge fields all populated, stop-conditions firing
